# Pulse

If a user asks you to install Pulse, do not start by running a command.
First audit the repo/package, explain the install plan, ask for confirmation,
then install.

Canonical user-facing prompt:

```text
Hi. Please check whether it is safe to install Pulse:
https://github.com/zbs-gg/pulse

Read README.md, AGENTS.md, llms.txt, and docs/SECURITY_INSTALL_CHECKLIST.md.
Check: npm view @zbs-gg/pulse dist-tags
Explain which harness path fits my setup, what Pulse writes, what it will not
do by default, and how I can erase it. Ask my confirmation before installing.

For Personal Pulse when Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex is installed:
  npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview install
  pulse doctor claude-code  # when detected
  pulse doctor cursor       # when detected
  pulse doctor codex        # when detected
  pulse home

For other MCP-compatible hosts:
  configure the host to run:
  npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview mcp
  and say plainly that this is Safe Mode/fallback, not the full state-aware
  Pulse engine.

No old-chat import without separate confirmation. No raw transcripts. No
secrets in output. Stop and explain if anything looks unsafe.
```

Pulse is a local-first, state-aware memory engine for AI agents: it retrieves
the right remembered episode for the user's current state — not just the
closest text match — shows why that memory surfaced, shows the continuity pack
the next agent receives, and wipes on one command. Host-extracted structured
capsules only; raw transcript capture is off by default (the store rejects
transcript/secret/path-like content); no backend model API keys by default.
Developer preview; host-neutral Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex support is
pending the matching signed preview publication; not production.

## Compatible harnesses

- Claude Code: native Personal plugin and lifecycle.
  `npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview install`
- Claude Desktop / local Claude MCP clients: MCP-compatible Safe Mode today.
  Configure `npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview mcp`.
- Cursor: native local Personal plugin and lifecycle; no Cursor CLI required.
  `npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview install`.
- Windsurf: MCP-compatible Safe Mode today.
  Configure `npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview mcp`.
- Codex / OpenAI local agents: native Personal plugin and lifecycle.
  `npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview install`.
- Gemini CLI: compatible when local MCP command servers are supported. Use
  agent audit first.
- LangChain / CrewAI / custom agents: integration surface; run Pulse MCP
  locally and call tools from the framework.
- ChatGPT app / Claude Directory / Pulse Cloud: future surfaces, not shipped
  in this preview.

Primary install (Pulse Personal):
`npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview install`, then run the exact doctor command for
each detected host (`claude-code`, `cursor`, or `codex`), then `pulse home`.
Requires Apple Silicon, Node 20+, a Git project, and any one
of Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. It requires no Go, Python, Make, Docker, or
model API key. The optional demo seeds an isolated SIMULATED corpus and proves:
same query in three user states returns different justified episodes
(visible per-line reasons: state/anchor/emotion/date boosts), old anchors
beat recent noise, and the next-agent continuity pack matches the evidence.
`pulse demo --clean` erases the demo store. Product doctor names the host and
only reports `Pulse <host> automatic lifecycle ready.` after native lifecycle
evidence and full retrieval pass. Safe Mode remains separately labeled.

Safe Mode (fallback, not the product):
`claude mcp add pulse -- npx -y @zbs-gg/pulse@preview mcp` — keyword-recall
structured local store with inspect/wipe for machines that can't run the
engine. No benchmark claims apply to this mode.

## Docs

- [Agent install + safety instructions](AGENTS.md): the script an AI agent
  follows to audit, explain, install, run doctor + the stateful demo, and
  show the exit path.
- [README](README.md): product overview, install matrix, trust boundaries.
- [Known limitations](mcp/docs/developer-preview/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)
- [Safe claims](mcp/docs/developer-preview/SAFE_CLAIMS.md)
- [Uninstall and wipe](mcp/docs/developer-preview/UNINSTALL_AND_WIPE.md)

## Packages

- [@zbs-gg/pulse on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zbs-gg/pulse): the
  one package — installer/CLI (init, doctor, demo, viewer) + MCP server
  (`pulse mcp`).
- One package only: the MCP server is bundled inside @zbs-gg/pulse
  (`pulse mcp`); the old @zbs-gg/pulse-mcp package is deprecated.

## Boundaries

- Not production ready; developer preview for technical users.
- Benchmark numbers apply to the full engine only — never to Safe Mode keyword
  recall — and are reported in the paper/bench, not reproduced in this repository.
- No automatic chat import; ingest is host-extracted by default and bulk
  import is explicit, preview-first, opt-in.
